name: Volumatic VIDYA
rule: Long when the close crosses above the upper band of Volumatic VIDYA (VIDYA 10, momentum 20, bands at 2 × ATR 200); cash when it crosses below the lower band. Volume is only drawn, it does not change the signal.
credit: Volumatic Variable Index Dynamic Average by BigBeluga (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): https://www.tradingview.com/script/llhVjhA5-Volumatic-Variable-Index-Dynamic-Average-BigBeluga/
conditions: Long only, 100% of equity, 0.1% commission per side, no slippage, fills at next open, default settings, trading from 2023-05-03.

text.en: Since 2023 this rule closed 6 trades and won 2 (33%). A trade lasts about 3 months on average. Its best trade was +281% (August 2024 to January 2025) and its worst −43% (May 2026 to June 2026). Without its three best trades, the other 3 together lose 74%. Its worst streak was 4 losses in a row. In 2024 it returned +549%; buying and holding Sui returned +432%. It uses wide bands around an adaptive average: it gives few signals and leaves a wide margin before exiting.
text.es: Desde 2023 esta regla cerró 6 operaciones y ganó en 2 (33 %). Una operación dura en promedio unos 3 meses. La mejor fue +281 % (agosto de 2024 a enero de 2025) y la peor −43 % (mayo de 2026 a junio de 2026). Sin sus tres mejores operaciones, las otras 3 juntas pierden 74 %. Su peor racha fue de 4 pérdidas seguidas. En 2024 rindió +549 %; comprar y mantener Sui rindió +432 %. Usa bandas anchas alrededor de una media adaptable: da pocas señales y deja un margen grande antes de salir.
